# bit runs the default group; ... runs every target that isn't explicit.
bit
stdout 'main ✔'
! stdout 'keep'
! exists keep.txt

bit ...
stdout 'keep ✔'
stdout 'heavy ✔'
! stdout 'manual'
! exists manual.txt

# An explicit target runs when named, or as a dependency.
bit needs-manual
stdout 'manual ✔'
grep '\Amanual\z' manual.txt

# --clean skips protected targets unless named, and explicit ones under ...
bit --clean ...
stdout 'keep ⊘ protected'
stdout 'heavy ▶ rm heavy.txt'
exists keep.txt manual.txt
! exists heavy.txt main.txt

bit --clean keep
stdout 'keep ▶ rm keep.txt'
! exists keep.txt

# A large target gets its own CI job.
exec git init -q
bit --ci github heavy main
stdout '^  heavy:'
stdout 'run: "bit heavy"'
stdout 'run: "bit main"'

-- BUILD.bit --
main = exec {
  command = "printf main > main.txt"
  outputs = "main.txt"
}

explicit manual = exec {
  command = "printf manual > manual.txt"
  outputs = "manual.txt"
}

explicit needs-manual = exec {
  command = "true"
  depends_on = [manual]
}

protected keep = exec {
  command = "printf keep > keep.txt"
  outputs = "keep.txt"
}

large heavy = exec {
  command = "printf heavy > heavy.txt"
  outputs = "heavy.txt"
}

# Build the main file.
group default = [main]
